title: Con-Quest
summary: A $5 interactive charity adventure hosted by the Gearbox Union, with table challenges, bottle caps, raffle tickets and prizes.

content.text: Con-Quest turns the convention floor into an interactive charity adventure benefiting children's hospitals. Donate $5 to receive a GBU Con-Quest pouch, five raffle tickets and a one-day questing pass.
How to Participate

items: Use the convention map to find participating Con-Quest tables.
Complete playful challenges such as character impressions, dances, quotes and other table activities.
Earn GBU Con-Quest bottle caps for completed quests.
Trade bottle caps at the Mega-Table for additional raffle tickets and more chances to win donated prizes.
New quests, changing trade values and hidden surprises can appear each day.

content.text: Start Your Quest
Begin at the Gearbox Union Con-Quest Mega-Table at Tables D1-D7, upstairs outside the ballroom. Pick up your materials, learn how the quest works and start exploring.
Vendors, Artists & Guests
Exhibitors can participate as quest stops by contributing to the charity raffle and offering a simple interactive challenge at their table. Contact GearboxUnion@gmail.com to participate.

items: The GBU Presents: The Con-Quest Charity Raffle • Sunday, Oct. 18 • 3:30-4:55 PM • Panel Room 2

title: Costume Contest
summary: Sci-Fi Valley Con's annual costume competition with junior, teen and adult divisions, plus special adult awards.

content.text: Show off costumes inspired by fantasy, science fiction, anime, steampunk, horror, movies, television, books and other fandoms. The contest celebrates creativity, craftsmanship and presentation.

items: Registration & optional prejudging: Saturday, Oct. 17 • 2:30-4:55 PM • Panel Room 2
Costume Contest: Saturday, Oct. 17 • 6:00 PM • Panel Room 1

content.text: Prizes & Age Divisions

items: 1st, 2nd and 3rd place trophies are awarded in each age division.
Adult contestants are also eligible for Best of Show and Judge's Choice.

content.text: Entry Information

Entrants should be ready to provide a costume title, the source or genre that inspired the costume, and details for the judges about construction, materials, craftsmanship and the story behind the piece.

title: Charity Quick Sketches
summary: Watch convention artists create one-of-a-kind sketches live, then bid on the finished artwork for charity.

content.text: Charity Quick Sketches brings artists together for fast-paced live drawing sessions. Attendees can shout out ideas and watch original pieces take shape in real time.
Art for a Good Cause

Finished sketches are auctioned immediately using raffle tickets, with proceeds supporting charity. Sci-Fi Valley Con provides the drawing materials so the participating artists can focus on creating.
If you cannot find artwork of a favorite character on the exhibitor floor, this is your chance to request something fun and potentially take home a unique piece created right in front of you.

title: Charity Auction
summary: A live auction of donated art, collectibles and memorabilia benefiting Extra Life and Children's Miracle Network Hospitals.

content.text: The Sci-Fi Valley Con Charity Auction combines collectible hunting with fundraising. Artists and creators donate artwork, sculptures, memorabilia and other unique items for attendees to bid on live.
Benefiting Extra Life
Auction proceeds support Extra Life and Children's Miracle Network Hospitals, helping turn convention collectibles into direct support for children in need.
The auction is open to Sci-Fi Valley Con attendees. Bring your preferred payment method, join the bidding and help raise money for a great cause.

title: Medieval Combat Demos
summary: Dagorhir battle-game demonstrations on the lawn with full-contact foam combat, safety instruction and opportunities for attendees to participate.

items: Saturday, Oct. 17 • 1:00-2:00 PM • Outside on the Lawn
Saturday, Oct. 17 • 4:00-5:00 PM • Outside on the Lawn

content.text: Members of the Wolves of Asgard and Iron Mountain units from Johnstown demonstrate the rules, equipment, techniques and safety practices used in Dagorhir, a full-contact fantasy combat sport using padded foam weapons.
The Gearbox Union helps energize the crowd, and after the demonstration attendees can try foam weapons themselves. Waivers are required, and minors must have parental supervision.

title: Retro Gaming Arcade Vault
summary: A playable museum celebrating more than 50 years of video game history with 75+ consoles, handhelds and classic computers.

content.text: Step into Sci-Fi Valley Con's Retro Gaming Arcade Vault and play through decades of gaming history. The collection spans the earliest home systems, classic 8-bit and 16-bit consoles, unusual hardware, handhelds and modern systems.
A Gamer's Paradise

The playable museum features more than 75 consoles and systems, giving longtime players a chance to revisit childhood favorites while introducing younger fans to the hardware that shaped modern gaming.

title: Tabletop Gaming
summary: All-weekend tabletop gaming hosted by Snake Eyes Gaming and Sentinels' Keep Gaming Society, with card games, miniatures, board games and special events.

content.text: The Game Room offers casual play, demos and organized tabletop events for experienced players and newcomers. Stop in throughout the weekend to learn something new, bring your own game or jump into an event.
Gaming Variety

items: Gaming demos & casual play: Friday through Sunday • All day • Game Room
Magic: The Gathering Casual Commander: Saturday • 11:00 AM-7:00 PM • Free admission

content.text: Warhammer 40k: Bug Hunt

A weekend-long, drop-in and drop-out Warhammer 40k event challenges players to control a unit, complete objectives and earn points through repeated missions. Play as often as you like. A special prize goes to the player with the most points at the end of the weekend, and new players are welcome.
Magic: The Gathering - Casual Commander
Four-player Commander pods launch on demand Saturday from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Promos are awarded to winners, admission is free and decks are available for purchase if needed.
HeroClix - Battle Royale
Draft a booster and join a four-player group battle in a 50-minute round. Pods launch on demand, with promos added to the prize pool. Admission is $5 or $15 depending on the booster selected.

title: Trivia Tournament
summary: Three days of geek trivia spanning sci-fi, fantasy, comics, movies, television, games and more, with trophies and Best Buy gift cards for top players.

content.text: Test your fandom knowledge against other attendees in a trivia tournament covering a wide range of geek culture. Come with friends or compete solo.
Questions span science fiction, fantasy, comics, movies, television, games and other fandom topics. Top trivia players can take home trophies and Best Buy gift cards.

title: Workshops
summary: Hands-on painting, model-building, 3D-printing and foam-smithing activities throughout the convention.

content.text: Sci-Fi Valley Con workshops give attendees a chance to paint, build, craft and learn hands-on skills with guidance from experienced creators.
Paint and Take & Build and Battle

Snake Eyes Gaming hosts Paint and Take and Build and Battle in the Paint and Hobby Room. Paint and Take provides a miniature and the tools needed to paint it. Build and Battle offers Gundam, Pokémon and Warhammer model choices, with supplies and guidance provided. Attendees under 18 must be accompanied by an adult for Build and Battle.

items: Friday • 2:00-8:00 PM • Paint and Hobby Room
Saturday • 10:00 AM-7:00 PM • Paint and Hobby Room
Sunday • 10:00 AM-3:00 PM • Paint and Hobby Room

content.text: The cost varies based on the miniature or model chosen and includes the item plus use of the provided tools and supplies.
Miniature Painting Competition
Participants receive a mystery miniature and shared painting supplies, then have two hours to complete the model. The artistic style is up to each painter.

items: Models and hobby supplies are provided. Personal models or hobby supplies may not be used.
Winners are announced Sunday at 2:00 PM in the Paint and Hobby Room.
1st, 2nd and 3rd place prizes are awarded in each category, based on attendance.

content.text: 3D Printing & Foam Smithing

Snowtiger Designs offers live demonstrations and hands-on learning focused on 3D printing and foam-smithing techniques used in cosplay and prop construction. Find them at Table D9 throughout the convention.
